about: The owner's own silent reaction videos (29 Oct 2026; 4K vertical on a phone, plain wall, grey T-shirt; no words, room sound only). Each holds one reaction for 5-8 s. They play as video inside our edits (vr.js). Frames: video/lib/vreact_prep.py writes video/out/vreact/<id>/full (the clip with the room) and cut (cut out by react_matte.py). dur is the clip's length; start is where a reaction usually starts in the clip; beats are moments inside it; face is the head in the 1080x1920 frame [centre x, centre y, top of the hair to the chin]; all in seconds and pixels.

reactions.name: The Grin
reactions.feel: proud, told you so, good news
use: a cheap fee or a bonus
reactions.beats: the grin is held the whole clip

reactions.name: Jaw Drop
reactions.beats: mouth open, hand on the chin, held the whole clip

reactions.name: Wait, What?
reactions.beats: frown and wide eyes, held the whole clip

reactions.name: Yikes
reactions.feel: cringe, awkward, that's going to hurt
reactions.beats: teeth bared, held the whole clip

reactions.name: It's Over
use: a stop loss or a dump
reactions.beats: the hands fly onto the head 0-0.75 s, held to 7.3 s, then drop

reactions.name: LOL
reactions.beats: a big open-mouth laugh the whole clip

reactions.name: Side-Eye
use: a bold prediction (Bitcoin might go up today)
a promise that sounds too good
reactions.beats: neutral to 1.9 s; a side-eye to the left of the screen 2.0-3.0 s, back to camera 3.25 s; a side-eye to the right 4.75-5.5 s, back 5.75 s

reactions.name: The Sob
use: my favourite isn't on the list
reactions.beats: the crying face is held the whole clip

reactions.name: The Wail
reactions.beats: a grimace to 0.75 s, the big wail 1.0-1.75 s, crying 2.0-3.75 s, settling to 5.5 s
